title: EventStorming Board Document, version 1
description: A whole EventStorming board in one document. Array order of 'elements' is timeline order (left to right). Positions are optional: anything without one is laid out automatically.

board.description: The board's name and level. Required when creating a board; when replacing, the name is optional and the level must match.

id.description: Ignored on import; present in exports.

name.description: The board's name, e.g. "Online food ordering".

elements.description: Every element on the board, in timeline order.

key.description: Your own name for this element, unique within the document, so other elements and connections can refer to it. Example: "order-placed".

type.description: An element type id from GET /api/v1/element-types, e.g. "domain-event".

text.description: What the sticky says. Domain Events in past tense: "Order Placed".

position.description: Top-left corner in board coordinates. Leave out to have the element placed on the timeline automatically.

size.description: Leave out to use the type's default size.

swimlane.description: Key of a 'swimlane' element this element sits in.

boundary.description: Key of a 'boundary' element (a bounded context) this element belongs to.

anchor.description: Key of another element to stack this one below, in the same column - e.g. a Hot Spot under the event it questions.

pivotal.description: Marks a pivotal Domain Event - a turning point of the story. Only for domain-event.

color.description: Optional color override as #RRGGBB. Leave out to use the type's color.

connections.description: Optional arrows between elements, referring to element keys.

from.description: Key of the element the arrow starts at.

to.description: Key of the element the arrow points to.
